title: approve: request
description: Answer a run's open cue by approving its changes: apply its captured diff to the theatre's working tree, unstaged, all or nothing, record the approval in the cue's role, then remove its worktree. A request never names a path, a diff or a role.

run.description: The run, by id or unique prefix.

reason.description: Why, in the person's words, recorded in lineage. Absent: none was given.

rehearse.description: Change nothing: check that the cue is open, the person may answer it, and the diff applies cleanly, and report the files it would change. Absent means false.
